docs.title: 10.4.9.5. src/components/FenetreConfirmation.tsx
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// components/FenetreConfirmation.tsx
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The “Are you sure?” window from Example 16, completed for keyboard use
// as public/js/app.js in the HTML application:
//    - Upon opening, the focus goes to "No, go back": an accidental press of
//      Enter does not delete anything;
//    - Esc closes the window (= No);
//    - Tab and Shift+Tab keep the focus on DANS the window (otherwise the focus would move to
//      the grayed-out page behind it);
//    - Upon closing, the focus returns to the element that had it (the
//      "Delete" button that was clicked, for example).
// "No, go back" rather than "Cancel": the question is sometimes “Cancel this
// appointment?”, and a “Cancel” button would be ambiguous in this context.
// The component is placed once in the template; it does not display anything
// the confirmation store has no question (see stores/confirmation.ts).
// =========================================================================

import { useEffect, useRef, type KeyboardEvent, type MouseEvent } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { useConfirmation } from '../stores/confirmation';

export default function FenetreConfirmation() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const cle = useConfirmation((c) => c.cleMessage);
  const reponse = useConfirmation((c) => c.reponse);
  const fenetre = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const boutonNon = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

   // The window opens: we retrieve the element that has focus and assign it
   // to the "No" button; the window closes (cleanup): focus is returned
  const ouverte = cle !== null;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ouverte) return;
    const focusPrecedent = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    boutonNon.current?.focus();
    return () => focusPrecedent?.focus();
  }, [ouverte]);

  if (cle === null) {
    return null; // window closed: nothing to display
  }

  function clavier(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      reponse(false);
    } else if (e.key === 'Tab' && fenetre.current) {
      const boutons = [...fenetre.current.querySelectorAll('button')];
      const premier = boutons[0];
      const dernier = boutons[boutons.length - 1];
      if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === premier) {
        e.preventDefault();
        dernier?.focus();
      } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === dernier) {
        e.preventDefault();
        premier?.focus();
      }
    }
  }

   // A click on the grayed-out background (not inside the window itself) = No
  function clicFond(e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
      reponse(false);
    }
  }

  return createPortal(
    <div onKeyDown={clavier}>
      <div className="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
      <div ref={fenetre} className="modal fade show d-block" tabIndex={-1} role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true"
           aria-labelledby="confirmation-titre" aria-describedby="confirmation-message" onClick={clicFond}>
        <div className="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
          <div className="modal-content">
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h5 id="confirmation-titre" className="modal-title">{t('CONFIRMATION.TITLE')}</h5>
              <button type="button" className="btn-close" aria-label={t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA')} onClick={() => reponse(false)}></button>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              <p id="confirmation-message" className="mb-0">{t(cle)}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-footer">
              <button ref={boutonNon} type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => reponse(false)}>
                {t('CONFIRMATION.NO')}
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="btn btn-danger" onClick={() => reponse(true)}>{t('CONFIRMATION.YES')}</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
}

The window from Example 16, linked to the confirmation store and completed for the keyboard:

  • lines 26–27: the question asked ([null]: window closed) and the function that answers it;
  • lines 33–39: an effect that depends on [ouverte]: upon opening, the element that has focus (the “Delete” button that was clicked) is retained, and focus is given to the “No, go back” button: an accidental press of Enter does not delete anything. Cleaning up the effect, performed upon closing, returns focus to the retained element;
  • lines 41–43: window closed: nothing to display. The hooks are called AVANT this [return]: they must be called each time the window is displayed, in the same order;
  • lines 45–60: Esc means “No.” Tab and Shift+Tab keep the window in DANS mode: Tab moves from the last button to the first, and vice versa; otherwise, the focus would move to the grayed-out page behind it;
  • lines 63–67: A click on the grayed-out background is treated as “No.” [e.target] is the clicked element, and [e.currentTarget] is the one that holds the handler: they are equal if the click occurred on the background itself, and not within the window;
  • Lines 69–94: [createPortal] (Example 16) displays the window at the end of [<body>], outside the page: no page style can distort it;
  • line 72: for a screen reader, a window requesting an urgent response; [aria-labelledby] and [aria-describedby] refer to its title and question.

docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// components/ChampSaisie.tsx - a completed form field
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Label + field + tooltip OU error message. All
// forms in the application use it:
//
//    <ChampSaisie idChamp="name" label="PERSONNES.LASTNAME_LABEL" longueurMax={20}
//                 value={saisie.nom} onChange={(v) => modify('name', v)} error={envoi.erreurs.nom} />
//
// This is a CONTRÔLÉ component (see Example 11): the value belongs to the
// parent form. The error is the one returned by the SERVEUR (see
// hooks/useEnvoiFormulaire.ts). Label, help, and error are CLÉS from
// translation; "params" refers to the parameters in their messages ({min}...).
// =========================================================================

import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

interface Props {
  idChamp: string; // the ID of the <input>, linked to the <label>
  libelle: string;
  valeur: string;
  onChange: (valeur: string) => void;
  erreur?: string;
  aide?: string;
  params?: Record<string, string>;
  type?: 'text' | 'password';
  longueurMax?: number;
  autoComplete?: string;
  requis?: boolean;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
  className?: string; // the block classes (mb-3, col-sm-6...)
}

export default function ChampSaisie({
  idChamp, libelle, valeur, onChange, erreur, aide, params = {}, type = 'text', longueurMax,
  autoComplete = 'off', requis = false, autoFocus = false, className = '',
}: Props) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const idMessage = `${idChamp}-message`;

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <label className="form-label" htmlFor={idChamp}>{t(libelle)}</label>
      <input id={idChamp} type={type} className={`form-control ${erreur ? 'is-invalid' : ''}`} value={valeur}
             onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} maxLength={longueurMax} autoComplete={autoComplete}
             required={requis} autoFocus={autoFocus} aria-invalid={erreur ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={idMessage} />
      {erreur ? (
        <div className="invalid-feedback" id={idMessage}>{t(erreur, params)}</div>
      ) : (
        aide && <div className="form-text" id={idMessage}>{t(aide, params)}</div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

A complete form field: label, field, help message OU, and error message. All forms in the application use it.

  • lines 18–32: its props; [libelle], [aide], and [erreur] are translation props (CLÉS);
  • lines 34–37: the unpacking of the props, with default values ([type = 'text']);
  • line 39: the identifier for the help or error message, which [aria-describedby] links to the field; a screen reader reads it along with the field;
  • lines 44–46: a CONTRÔLÉ field (example 05): its value belongs to the parent form, which receives it via [onChange]. [is-invalid]: the red box from [Bootstrap];
  • lines 47–51: the error returned by the server, otherwise the help text.

docs.title: 10.4.9.8. src/components/ChampCaptcha.tsx
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// components/ChampCaptcha.tsx - the CAPTCHA image and the input field
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A display component: the image (SVG), the "Another image" link
// (onRecharger), and the field, CONTRÔLÉ, via the parent form (value,
// onChange). The image and its ID come from the hook useCaptcha, which
// is called by the parent (see pages/Connexion.tsx): it is the parent that needs
// to send the response.
//
// dangerouslySetInnerHTML: the image SVG is inserted as-is. Without
// any risk ICI because it is generated by our server (
// svg-captcha) and contains nothing provided by a user—see
// Example 22.
// =========================================================================

import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

interface Props {
  svg: string;
  valeur: string;
  onChange: (valeur: string) => void;
  onRecharger: () => void;
  erreur?: string;
}

export default function ChampCaptcha({ svg, valeur, onChange, onRecharger, erreur }: Props) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <div className="mb-3">
      <label className="form-label" htmlFor="captcha">{t('CAPTCHA.LABEL')}</label>
      <div className="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mb-2">
        <div className="captcha-image" role="img" aria-label={t('CAPTCHA.IMAGE_ALT')} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: svg }} />
        <button type="button" className="btn btn-link btn-sm p-0" onClick={onRecharger}>{t('CAPTCHA.NEW_IMAGE')}</button>
      </div>
      <input id="captcha" type="text" maxLength={10} autoComplete="off" autoCapitalize="off" spellCheck={false}
             className={`form-control ${erreur ? 'is-invalid' : ''}`} value={valeur} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} />
      {erreur ? <div className="invalid-feedback">{t(erreur)}</div> : <div className="form-text">{t('CAPTCHA.HELP')}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

A display component: the image, the “Other Image” button, and the field, controlled by the parent form. The image and its identifier come from the [useCaptcha] hook, which the page calls: the page needs it to send the response.

  • Line 32: The image SVG is inserted as-is (Example 22). Safe ICI: It is generated by our server and contains nothing provided by a user. [role="img"] and [aria-label]: For a screen reader, this is an image with its description;
  • line 35: [autoCapitalize="off"] and [spellCheck={false}]: no automatic capitalization (phones) or spell check.

docs.title: 10.4.9.9. src/components/FenetreReservation.tsx
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// components/FenetreReservation.tsx - the slot reservation window
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Same window as views/partials/reservation.hbs from the HTML application:
// The Bootstrap classes of a modal window, hard-coded (show
// d-block).
//
// The component does not communicate with the server: it calls
//    - onConfirmer, with the selected patient (null for a patient who is booking
//      for themselves);
//    - onFermer.
// The calendar page determines what to do with it (pages/Agenda.tsx).
// =========================================================================

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent, type MouseEvent } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import type { Personne } from '../api/types';
import { libelle } from '../formatage';

interface Props {
  horaire: string; // "8:00 - 8:20"
  clients: readonly Personne[]; // ADMIN / DOCTOR: the patients to choose from
  patient: string | null; // USER: the patient is the patient himself
  envoiEnCours: boolean;
  onConfirmer: (idClient: number | null) => void;
  onFermer: () => void;
}

export default function FenetreReservation({ horaire, clients, patient, envoiEnCours, onConfirmer, onFermer }: Props) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [idClient, setIdClient] = useState<number | null>(null);

   // Esc, anywhere on the page: closes the window
  useEffect(() => {
    const clavier = (e: globalThis.KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onFermer();
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', clavier);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', clavier);
  }, [onFermer]);

  function confirmer(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    onConfirmer(idClient);
  }

   // Clicking on the gray background (not inside the window itself) closes the window
  function clicFond(e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
      onFermer();
    }
  }

  return createPortal(
    <>
      <div className="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
      <div className="modal fade show d-block" tabIndex={-1} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="titre-reservation"
           onClick={clicFond}>
        <div className="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
          <form className="modal-content" onSubmit={confirmer}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h5 id="titre-reservation" className="modal-title">{t('BOOKING_DIALOG.TITLE')}</h5>
              <button type="button" className="btn-close" aria-label={t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA')} onClick={onFermer}></button>
            </div>

            <div className="modal-body">
              <p>{t('BOOKING_DIALOG.SLOT', { horaire })}</p>
              {/* A patient makes a reservation for themselves: no list (and the server
                  ignorerait de toute façon un éventuel idClient) */}
              {patient !== null ? (
                <p className="mb-0">{t('BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL')} : <strong>{patient}</strong></p>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <label className="form-label" htmlFor="idClient">{t('BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL')}</label>
                  {/* autoFocus: when displayed, the focus is on the list */}
                  <select id="idClient" className="form-select" autoFocus value={idClient ?? ''}
                          onChange={(e) => setIdClient(e.target.value === '' ? null : Number(e.target.value))}>
                    <option value="">{t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CHOOSE_PATIENT')}</option>
                    {clients.map((c) => <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{libelle(c)}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="modal-footer">
              <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={onFermer}>{t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CANCEL')}</button>
              {/* No list; the confirmation button has focus */}
              <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" autoFocus={patient !== null} disabled={envoiEnCours}>
                {t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CONFIRM')}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>,
    document.body,
  );
}

The appointment booking window. It does not communicate with the server: it calls [onConfirmer] with the selected patient, or [onFermer]; the calendar page decides what to do with it.

  • Lines 21–28: [clients]: the list of patients, for ADMIN and the doctors; [patient]: the name of the patient making the appointment for themselves ([null] for ADMIN and the doctors);
  • line 32: the patient selected from the list;
  • lines 35–41: Esc, anywhere on the page, closes the window. The effect subscribes to the document’s [keydown] event, and its cleanup unsubscribes upon closing. [globalThis.KeyboardEvent]: the browser event, not the one from [React], which has the same name;
  • lines 43–46: [preventDefault()] prevents the browser from submitting the form;
  • lines 71–83: A patient is making a reservation for themselves: no list. The server would ignore any [idClient] in any case;
  • line 78: the value of a [<option>] is always a string: it is converted to a number;
  • line 89: without a list, the confirmation button receives focus.

docs.title: 10.4.10.1. src/pages/Connexion.tsx
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/Connexion.tsx - the login page (/login)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Same page as views/login.hbs in the HTML application: login, password
// password, CAPTCHA, and a second "Create a Customer Account" button that verifies
// the MÊME captcha before allowing the account creation process to proceed.
//
// /login?login=jbernard: the login field is pre-filled (immediately after
// account creation).
// /login?redirect=/medecins: after logging in, this page opens
// (stored by the router) rather than the role’s home page.
// =========================================================================

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { api } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { pageAccueil, useSession } from '../stores/session';
import { useMessages } from '../stores/messages';
import { useEnvoiFormulaire } from '../hooks/useEnvoiFormulaire';
import { useCaptcha } from '../hooks/useCaptcha';
import ChampCaptcha from '../components/ChampCaptcha';
import TitrePage from '../components/TitrePage';

export default function Connexion() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [parametres] = useSearchParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const connecter = useSession((s) => s.connecter);
  const effacerMessages = useMessages((m) => m.effacer);
  const envoi = useEnvoiFormulaire();
  const captcha = useCaptcha();

   // the login for URL, if one exists: the value of DÉPART in the field
  const loginUrl = (parametres.get('login') ?? '').slice(0, 30);
  const [saisie, setSaisie] = useState({ login: loginUrl, password: '', captcha: '' });

  function modifier(champ: keyof typeof saisie, valeur: string) {
    setSaisie((s) => ({ ...s, [champ]: valeur }));
    envoi.effacerErreur(champ);
  }

   // both buttons follow this sequence: submit, then, if that fails,
   // error message and NOUVELLE image (each is used only once)
  async function tenter(action: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<void> {
    effacerMessages();
    const reussi = await envoi.envoyer(action);
    if (!reussi) {
      setSaisie((s) => ({ ...s, captcha: '' }));
      await captcha.recharger();
    }
  }

  async function seConnecter(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    await tenter(async () => {
      await connecter(saisie.login.trim(), saisie.password, captcha.captchaId, saisie.captcha);
      const redirect = parametres.get('redirect');
       // only one path INTERNE: never redirect to another site
      const interne = redirect !== null && redirect.startsWith('/') && !redirect.startsWith('//');
      await navigate(interne ? redirect : pageAccueil(useSession.getState().utilisateur));
    });
  }

  async function creerCompte() {
    await tenter(async () => {
      await api.accesInscription(captcha.captchaId, saisie.captcha);
      await navigate('/inscription');
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="row justify-content-center">
      <TitrePage cle="LOGIN.TITLE" />
      <div className="col-sm-8 col-md-6 col-lg-5">
        <div className="card p-4">
          <h5 className="card-title mb-3">{t('LOGIN.TITLE')}</h5>

          <form onSubmit={seConnecter}>
            <div className="mb-3">
              <label className="form-label" htmlFor="login">{t('LOGIN.LOGIN_LABEL')}</label>
              {/* required: the browser refuses to submit the form as long as the field is empty.
                  autoFocus : le focus sur le login... ou sur le mot de passe si le login est déjà rempli */}
              <input id="login" type="text" className="form-control" autoComplete="username" required
                     autoFocus={loginUrl === ''} value={saisie.login} onChange={(e) => modifier('login', e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div className="mb-3">
              <label className="form-label" htmlFor="password">{t('LOGIN.PASSWORD_LABEL')}</label>
              <input id="password" type="password" className="form-control" autoComplete="current-password" required
                     autoFocus={loginUrl !== ''} value={saisie.password} onChange={(e) => modifier('password', e.target.value)} />
            </div>

            <ChampCaptcha svg={captcha.svg} valeur={saisie.captcha} onChange={(v) => modifier('captcha', v)}
                          onRecharger={captcha.recharger} erreur={envoi.erreurs.captcha} />

            {/* type="submit": Entering text in a field triggers "Log In" */}
            <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary w-100" disabled={envoi.enCours}>{t('LOGIN.SUBMIT')}</button>

            {/* type="button": This button does not submit the form (and ignores
                donc les champs required, inutiles ici) */}
            <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline-primary w-100 mt-3" disabled={envoi.enCours} onClick={creerCompte}>
              {t('LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT')}
            </button>
            <div className="form-text text-center">{t('LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT_HELP')}</div>
          </form>

          <div className="text-muted small mt-3">
            {t('LOGIN.DEMO_ACCOUNTS')}
            <ul className="mb-0 mt-1">
              <li><code>admin</code> - {t('LOGIN.DEMO_ADMIN')}</li>
              <li><code>pelissier</code>, <code>tatou</code>, <code>dupont</code> - {t('LOGIN.DEMO_DOCTOR')}</li>
              <li><code>martin</code>, <code>durand</code>, <code>bistrou</code>, <code>german</code> - {t('LOGIN.DEMO_USER')}</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

The [views/login.hbs] page of the HTML application: login, password, CAPTCHA, and a second "Create a Customer Account" button that verifies the MÊME CAPTCHA before allowing the account creation process to begin.

  • Lines 29–32: What the page needs: login (session storage), clearing messages, submitting the form, and the CAPTCHA (our two hooks);
  • Lines 35–36: [/login?login=jbernard]: Immediately after creating an account, the username is pre-filled. [slice(0, 30)]: We do not retrieve more than the maximum length of a username. URL returns only the value of the field from DÉPART;
  • lines 38–41: when a field is entered, its new value appears and any error message disappears. [[champ]: valeur]: a property whose name is calculated;
  • lines 45–52: both buttons follow the same sequence: submit, then, if that fails, clear the CAPTCHA and load a NOUVELLE image; each is used only once;
  • lines 54–63: login, then the next page:
    • line 58: the page requested before login, cached by the router ([/login?redirect=/medecins]);
    • line 60: SEULEMENT an internal path: [/medecins], but not [https://site-pirate.com] or [//site-pirate.com] (a “protocol-less” address, which points to another site). Otherwise, a malicious link such as [/login?redirect=https://...] would send the user—who has just logged in—to another site: this is the so-called “open redirection” vulnerability;
    • line 61: otherwise, the role’s home page. [useSession.getState()]: the user QUI VIENT is stored in the store; a component’s variable, however, will not change until the next page load;
  • lines 65–70: the second button: the CAPTCHA is verified by the server, which returns a token (a cookie) for the page [/inscription];
  • lines 84–85: [required]: the browser refuses to submit the form as long as the field is empty. This is the only validation performed in the browser—it’s simply a convenience feature. [autoFocus]: Focus is on the username field, or on the password field if the username is already filled in (line 90);
  • line 97: [type="submit"]: Typing in a field triggers the “Log In” button;
  • line 101: [type="button"]: this button does not submit the form and therefore ignores the [required] fields, which are unnecessary here.

docs.title: 10.4.10.2. src/pages/Agenda.tsx
docs.text:
The most feature-rich page in the application. As in the HTML and TOUT applications, its state is stored in URL:

/agenda?idMedecin=1&jour=2026-10-05              l'agenda
/agenda?idMedecin=1&jour=2026-10-05&reserver=7   + la fenêtre de réservation

The SUIT page is contained within URL: it reads its parameters and uses them to determine what to display; user actions, in turn, modify URL. This allows you to reload the page, bookmark it, and use the browser’s Back and Forward buttons.

// =========================================================================
// pages/Agenda.tsx - the calendar page (/agenda)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Three blocks, like views/agenda.hbs from the HTML application:
//    1. Selecting the doctor and the day;
//    2. that doctor’s schedule for that day;
//    3. the appointment booking window.
//
// As in the HTML application, TOUT the page status is in its URL:
//      /agenda?idMedecin=1&day=2026-10-            05 the calendar
//      /agenda?idMedecin=1&day=2026-10-05&reserve= 7 + the reservation window
// You can therefore reload the page, bookmark it, or use the
// Back / Forward buttons in the browser. The page SUIT is URL: it reads its
// three parameters (useSearchParams) and uses them to determine what to display;
// the calendar is a TanStack query whose key contains the doctor
// and the day (see Example 24); the user’s actions, on the other hand,
// change the URL (navigate).
//
// What each user sees and can do is determined by the SERVEUR (fields
// patient, me, bookable, idRv for each time slot): the page simply
// display it. A patient does not even see the names of the other patients.
// =========================================================================

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { ErreurApi } from '../api/erreur-api';
import { api } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { CreneauAgenda, Personne } from '../api/types';
import { aujourdhui, estUneDateValide, horaire, jourLong, libelle } from '../formatage';
import { estGestionnaire, estPatient, useSession } from '../stores/session';
import { useMessages } from '../stores/messages';
import { confirmer } from '../stores/confirmation';
import FenetreReservation from '../components/FenetreReservation';
import TitrePage from '../components/TitrePage';

// "3" -> 3; "", "abc", "-2", absent (null) -> null
function entierPositif(valeur: string | null): number | null {
  const n = Number(valeur);
  return valeur !== null && valeur !== '' && Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0 ? n : null;
}

// the calendar address (with or without a booking window)
function adresseAgenda(idMedecin: number | null, jour: string, reserver?: number): string {
  const parametres = new URLSearchParams({ idMedecin: String(idMedecin ?? ''), jour });
  if (reserver !== undefined) {
    parametres.set('reserver', String(reserver));
  }
  return `/agenda?${parametres}`;
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. Selecting the doctor and the day: a short form, the status of which
// is used only before submission. It DÉMARRE with the values from the URL; the page
// provides a key that changes along with them: React then recreates it, and it
// resets to the new values (Back button...).
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
interface PropsChoix {
  medecins: Personne[];
  idMedecin: number | null;
  jour: string;
  onVoir: (idMedecin: number | null, jour: string) => void;
}

function ChoixMedecinJour({ medecins, idMedecin, jour, onVoir }: PropsChoix) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [choixMedecin, setChoixMedecin] = useState(idMedecin);
  const [choixJour, setChoixJour] = useState(jour);

  function voir(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    onVoir(choixMedecin, choixJour);
  }

  return (
    <form className="card p-3 mb-3" onSubmit={voir}>
      <div className="row g-2 align-items-end">
        <div className="col-sm-5">
          <label className="form-label" htmlFor="idMedecin">{t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DOCTOR_LABEL')}</label>
          <select id="idMedecin" className="form-select" required value={choixMedecin ?? ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setChoixMedecin(entierPositif(e.target.value))}>
            <option value="">{t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.CHOOSE_DOCTOR')}</option>
            {medecins.map((m) => <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{libelle(m)}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="col-sm-4">
          <label className="form-label" htmlFor="jour">{t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DAY_LABEL')}</label>
          <input id="jour" type="date" className="form-control" required value={choixJour}
                 onChange={(e) => setChoixJour(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
        <div className="col-sm-3">
          <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary w-100">{t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.VIEW_AGENDA')}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the page
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
export default function Agenda() {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const utilisateur = useSession((s) => s.utilisateur);
   // the message store actions: functions that never change
   // ; getState() returns them without subscribing the page to messages
  const { afficherSucces, afficherErreur, afficherErreurApi, flash } = useMessages.getState();
  const [envoiEnCours, setEnvoiEnCours] = useState(false);

   // the parameters of the URL
  const [parametres] = useSearchParams();
  const idMedecinUrl = entierPositif(parametres.get('idMedecin'));
  const jourUrl = parametres.get('jour');
  const idReserver = entierPositif(parametres.get('reserver'));
   // the day: the day from URL if valid, otherwise today
  const jourInvalide = jourUrl !== null && !estUneDateValide(jourUrl);
  const jour = jourUrl !== null && !jourInvalide ? jourUrl : aujourdhui();

   // the lists: all doctors; patients only for those
   // who are authorized to view them (ADMIN, DOCTOR: booking window)
  const medecins = useQuery({ queryKey: ['medecins'], queryFn: () => api.lister('medecins') });
  const clients = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['clients'],
    queryFn: () => api.lister('clients'),
    enabled: estGestionnaire(utilisateur),
  });

   // the calendar: without a doctor in the URL, a DOCTOR sees the SON calendar (the
   // the server retrieves it using the token); the others see nothing
  const avecAgenda = !jourInvalide && (idMedecinUrl !== null || utilisateur?.role === 'DOCTOR');
  const agenda = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['agenda', idMedecinUrl, jour],
    queryFn: () => api.agenda(idMedecinUrl, jour),
    enabled: avecAgenda,
  });
  const a = avecAgenda ? agenda.data : undefined;
   // The doctor displayed: the one from the URL, or the one from the received calendar (DOCTOR)
  const idMedecin = idMedecinUrl ?? a?.medecin.id ?? null;

   // an invalid date in the URL: a message (a EFFET: the action is performed on the
   // message store, not on this component’s display)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (jourInvalide) {
      afficherErreur('ERRORS.INVALID_DATE');
    }
  }, [jourInvalide, afficherErreur]);

   // the time slot for which the reservation window is open (?reserver=7),
   // only if it can be booked by this user
  const creneauAReserver = a?.creneaux.find((c) => c.id === idReserver && c.reservable) ?? null;
   // the name of the logged-in patient (USER), or null for ADMIN and DOCTOR
  const patient = estPatient(utilisateur) ? (utilisateur?.nom ?? '') : null;

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // actions
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

   // "View Calendar": the URL is updated, and the page reloads
  function voirAgenda(idMedecinChoisi: number | null, jourChoisi: string) {
    navigate(adresseAgenda(idMedecinChoisi, jourChoisi));
  }

   // useCallback: the MÊME varies from one display to another (the
   // reservation window uses it in the dependencies of an action)
  const fermerReservation = useCallback(() => navigate(adresseAgenda(idMedecin, jour)), [navigate, idMedecin, jour]);

   // The server is the authoritative source: after each action, the calendar is re-read
   // (and the patient’s dashboard, which displays their appointment)
  const recharger = () =>
    Promise.all([queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['agenda'] }), queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['mon-espace'] })]);

  async function confirmerReservation(idClient: number | null) {
    if (creneauAReserver === null) {
      return;
    }
    setEnvoiEnCours(true);
    try {
      await api.reserver(jour, creneauAReserver.id, estGestionnaire(utilisateur) ? idClient : null);
      flash('succes', 'AGENDA.BOOKED');
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof ErreurApi && e.cle === 'ERRORS.CHOOSE_PATIENT') {
         // No patient selected: the window remains open
        afficherErreur(e.cle);
        return; // (finally runs anyway)
      }
      if (!(e instanceof ErreurApi)) {
        throw e;
      }
       // slot already taken, patient already has an appointment...:
       // the message will appear on the calendar; window closed
      flash('erreur', e.cle, e.params);
    } finally {
      setEnvoiEnCours(false);
    }
    await fermerReservation();
    await recharger();
  }

  async function annuler(c: CreneauAgenda) {
    if (c.idRv === null || !(await confirmer('AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM'))) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await api.annulerRv(c.idRv);
      afficherSucces('AGENDA.CANCELLED');
    } catch (e) {
      afficherErreurApi(e);
    }
    await recharger();
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // display
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  let contenu;
  if (agenda.isLoading && !a) {
    contenu = <p className="text-muted">{t('APP.LOADING')}</p>;
  } else if (a) {
    contenu = (
      <div className="card p-3">
        <h5>{t('AGENDA.TITLE_PREFIX')} {jourLong(a.jour, i18n.language)} - {libelle(a.medecin)}</h5>
        {a.creneaux.length > 0 ? (
          <table className="table table-hover align-middle">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>{t('AGENDA.COLUMN_SLOT')}</th>
                <th>{t('AGENDA.COLUMN_STATUS')}</th>
                <th></th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {a.creneaux.map((c) => (
                <tr key={c.id} className={c.reservable ? 'creneau-libre' : ''}>
                  <td>{horaire(c)}</td>
                  <td>
                    {c.libre ? (
                      <span className="badge text-bg-success">{t('AGENDA.FREE')}</span>
                    ) : c.patient ? (
                      <span className={`badge ${c.moi ? 'text-bg-primary' : 'text-bg-secondary'}`}>{libelle(c.patient)}</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="badge text-bg-secondary">{t('AGENDA.BOOKED_BY_OTHER')}</span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td className="text-end">
                    {/* "Book" is a LIEN: it adds &reserver=... to the URL, this
                        qui ouvre la fenêtre de réservation */}
                    {c.reservable && (
                      <Link className="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success" to={adresseAgenda(idMedecin, jour, c.id)}>
                        {t('AGENDA.BOOK')}
                      </Link>
                    )}
                    {c.idRv !== null && (
                      <button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" onClick={() => annuler(c)}>
                        {t('AGENDA.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT')}
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-muted mb-0">{t('AGENDA.NO_SLOTS')}</p>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  } else {
    contenu = <p className="text-muted">{t('AGENDA.EMPTY_STATE')}</p>;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <TitrePage cle="AGENDA.PAGE_TITLE" />
      <ChoixMedecinJour key={`${idMedecin}|${jour}`} medecins={medecins.data ?? []} idMedecin={idMedecin} jour={jour}
                        onVoir={voirAgenda} />

      {/* a patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no "Book" button */}
      {a?.info && (
        <div className="alert alert-info">
          {t(a.info)} <Link to="/mon-espace" className="alert-link">{t('APP.MENU_MY_SPACE')}</Link>
        </div>
      )}

      {contenu}

      {/* 3. The booking window, only if the URL contains &reserve=... */}
      {creneauAReserver && (
        <FenetreReservation horaire={horaire(creneauAReserver)} clients={clients.data ?? []} patient={patient}
                            envoiEnCours={envoiEnCours} onConfirmer={confirmerReservation} onFermer={fermerReservation} />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
  • lines 39–42: one parameter of URL is a string entered by anyone; only a positive integer is retained;
  • lines 45–51: the calendar’s URL, with or without a booking window;
  • lines 66–98: the form for selecting a doctor and date, a component of the same file. Its state is only used before submission: it is populated with the values from URL (lines 68–69). However, [useState(valeur)] only uses its value during display: if the URL changes (using the “Back” button), the form would retain the previous selection. Hence the key assigned to it by the page, further down;
  • lines 114–120: the parameters for URL. The day: the day from URL if it is valid, otherwise today;
  • lines 124–129: the lists, with [TanStack Query] (example 24). The key [['medecins']] refers to the data in the cache: another page requesting the same key receives it without a new request. [enabled]: patients, only for those authorized to view them (ADMIN and doctors, for the appointment window); for a patient, the request is not sent;
  • lines 133–138: the schedule. Its key contains the doctor and the day: when URL changes, the key changes, and [TanStack Query] sends the new request on its own. If there is no doctor in the URL, a logged-in doctor sees the SON calendar; others see nothing;
  • line 141: the displayed doctor: the one from URL, otherwise the one from the received calendar;
  • lines 145–149: an invalid date in the URL: a message. This is a EFFET: we act on the message store, not on the display of this component. We never modify another state while the display is active;
  • line 153: the time slot whose reservation window is open ([?reserver=7]), only if it is bookable by this user: a manually created URL does not open anything;
  • lines 162–164: “View Calendar” changes the URL; the page updates accordingly;
  • line 168: closing the window returns you to the calendar’s URL. [useCallback]: The MÊME varies from one view to another, because the reservation window uses it within the dependencies of an effect (see [FenetreReservation.tsx]): a new function for each view would trigger the effect each time;
  • Lines 172–173: The server’s data takes precedence: after each action, the calendar (and the patient’s space, which displays their appointment) is refreshed. [TanStack Query] immediately re-reads the displayed data; data that is not displayed will be re-read the next time it is used;
  • lines 175–200: the reservation:
    • line 181: the ADMIN and the doctors send the selected patient; a patient makes a reservation for themselves;
    • Line 182: The message will appear after the navigation action that closes the window;
    • Lines 184–188: No patient selected: the window remains open, displaying the message. [return] within a [try]: the [finally] block executes anyway;
    • line 194: other errors (slot already taken, patient already has an appointment, etc.) will be displayed on the calendar, with the window closed;
  • lines 202–213: cancellation, after confirmation: [await confirmer(...)] waits for the user’s response (see [stores/confirmation.ts]);
  • lines 218–272: the main content, calculated before JSX: a waiting message, the calendar, or a prompt to select a doctor. A standard [if / else] is often more readable than a cascade of [? :] messages within the JSX;
  • lines 239–245: the slot status: available, the patient’s name (in blue if it’s the logged-in patient), or “Reserved”: a patient does not receive the names of other patients via PAS; the server does not send them;
  • lines 250–254: “Reserve” is a LIEN, [<Link>]: it adds [&reserver=...] to URL, which opens the reservation window;
  • line 255: “Cancel,” if the server has indicated that the user can cancel this appointment;
  • line 277: The form key contains the doctor and the day. When these change, the key changes: [React] destroys the form and creates a new one, which starts with the new values. This is how [React] “resets” a component;
  • Lines 281–285: A patient who already has an upcoming appointment: this explains why there is no “Book” button;
  • lines 290–293: the booking window appears only if URL contains [&reserver=...].

// =========================================================================
// pages/personnes.config.ts - doctors or clients?
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The pages for managing doctors and clients are IDENTIQUES: same
// list, same form. As in the HTML application (abstract class
// PersonnesController), they are written UNE times (Personnes.tsx,
// PersonneFormulaire.tsx); only the address of the API and the
// label keys, as described here. The router passes the type to each page
// (see routes.tsx).
// =========================================================================

import type { TypePersonnes } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';

export interface ClesPersonnes {
  titre: string; // "Doctors"
  ajouter: string; // "Add a doctor"
  modifier: string; // "Edit a doctor"
  vide: string; // "No doctors."
  confirmerSuppression: string;
  ajoute: string; // "The doctor {name} has been added (login: {login})."
  modifie: string;
  supprime: string;
}

export const CLES_PERSONNES: Record<TypePersonnes, ClesPersonnes> = {
  medecins: {
    titre: 'MEDECINS.TITLE',
    ajouter: 'MEDECINS.ADD',
    modifier: 'MEDECINS.EDIT',
    vide: 'MEDECINS.EMPTY',
    confirmerSuppression: 'MEDECINS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
    ajoute: 'MEDECINS.ADDED',
    modifie: 'MEDECINS.UPDATED',
    supprime: 'MEDECINS.DELETED',
  },
  clients: {
    titre: 'CLIENTS.TITLE',
    ajouter: 'CLIENTS.ADD',
    modifier: 'CLIENTS.EDIT',
    vide: 'CLIENTS.EMPTY',
    confirmerSuppression: 'CLIENTS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
    ajoute: 'CLIENTS.ADDED',
    modifie: 'CLIENTS.UPDATED',
    supprime: 'CLIENTS.DELETED',
  },
};

// {name} and {login} "added / edited / deleted" messages
export function parametres(p: { prenom: string; nom: string; login?: string }): Record<string, string> {
  return { nom: `${p.prenom} ${p.nom}`, login: p.login ?? '' };
}

The pages for managing doctors and clients are IDENTIQUES: same list, same form. Like the HTML application (abstract class [PersonnesController]), they are written UNE times; the only things that change are the address of the API (the type, ['medecins'] or ['clients']) and the label keys, described here.

  • lines 14–23: the translation keys specific to each type;
  • line 25: [Record<TypePersonnes, ClesPersonnes>]: an object that has exactly one property per type; [medecins] and [clients]: the compiler reports a missing element;
  • lines 49–51: the parameters [{{nom}}] and [{{login}}] for the “added / modified / deleted” messages.

// =========================================================================
// pages/Personnes.tsx - list of doctors OU for clients (ADMIN)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A single page for both: the type ("doctors" or "clients") is set
// as a property (see routes.tsx); the specific labels for each are in
// personnes.config.ts. Equivalent to views/people/liste.hbs in
// the HTML application.
// =========================================================================

import { Link } from 'react-router';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { api, type TypePersonnes } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { Personne } from '../api/types';
import { useMessages } from '../stores/messages';
import { confirmer } from '../stores/confirmation';
import TitrePage from '../components/TitrePage';
import { CLES_PERSONNES, parametres } from './personnes.config';

export default function Personnes({ type }: { type: TypePersonnes }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const cles = CLES_PERSONNES[type];
   // the list; the key contains the type: doctors and clients each have their own
  const personnes = useQuery({ queryKey: [type], queryFn: () => api.lister(type) });

  async function supprimer(p: Personne) {
    if (!(await confirmer(cles.confirmerSuppression))) {
      return;
    }
    const messages = useMessages.getState();
    try {
      await api.supprimer(type, p.id);
      messages.afficherSucces(cles.supprime, parametres(p));
    } catch (e) {
       // a doctor who still has appointments: 409 ERRORS.DOCTOR_HAS_APPOINTMENTS
      messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
    }
    await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [type] });
  }

  const liste = personnes.data;
  let contenu;
  if (liste === undefined) {
     // not yet loaded (or loading failed: the message is at the bottom of the page)
    contenu = <p className="text-muted mb-0">{t('APP.LOADING')}</p>;
  } else if (liste.length === 0) {
    contenu = <p className="text-muted mb-0">{t(cles.vide)}</p>;
  } else {
    contenu = (
      <table className="table table-hover align-middle mb-0">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>{t('PERSONNES.COLUMN_TITLE')}</th>
            <th>{t('PERSONNES.COLUMN_FIRSTNAME')}</th>
            <th>{t('PERSONNES.COLUMN_LASTNAME')}</th>
            <th>{t('PERSONNES.COLUMN_LOGIN')}</th>
            <th></th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {liste.map((p) => (
            <tr key={p.id}>
              <td>{p.titre}</td>
              <td>{p.prenom}</td>
              <td>{p.nom}</td>
              <td><code>{p.login}</code></td>
              <td className="text-end">
                <div className="d-inline-flex gap-2">
                  <Link className="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" to={`/${type}/${p.id}/modifier`}>{t('PERSONNES.EDIT')}</Link>
                  <button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" onClick={() => supprimer(p)}>
                    {t('PERSONNES.DELETE')}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <TitrePage cle={cles.titre} />
      <div className="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">
        <h4 className="mb-0">{t(cles.titre)}</h4>
        <Link className="btn btn-primary" to={`/${type}/ajouter`}>{t(cles.ajouter)}</Link>
      </div>
      <div className="card p-3">{contenu}</div>
    </>
  );
}

The list of doctors or clients. The type is passed as a property (see [routes.tsx]).

  • Line 25: the list. Its key is the type: doctors and clients each have their own. The list of doctors is the MÊME data, just like the calendar list (key [['medecins']]): both benefit from the cache;
  • Lines 27–40: Deletion, after confirmation, followed by reloading the list. A doctor who still has appointments cannot be deleted: the server returns a 409 response, and a message is displayed at the bottom of the page;
  • line 31: [getState()] provides the store’s features without subscribing the page to messages: it does not need to be reloaded when a message changes;
  • lines 44–81: the content: “Loading…,” “No doctors,” or the table;
  • line 70: “Edit” is a link to the form page.

docs.title: 10.4.10.5. src/pages/PersonneFormulaire.tsx
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/PersonneFormulaire.tsx - creation OU modification of a doctor or
// a client (ADMIN)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//      /doctors/add           -> creation (no id parameter)
//      /doctors/3/edit        -> edit (id parameter = "3")
// (and the same URLs under /clients). Equivalent to
// views/people/formulaire.hbs from the HTML application.
//
// Two components:
//    - PersonneFormulaire reads the record to be modified (if there is one);
//    - The form is displayed only after the record has been read: it DÉMARRE with
//      its values (initial state), without having to re-enter them later.
// No rules are checked here: the server accepts everything, and any errors
// are displayed below the fields (see hooks/useEnvoiFormulaire.ts).
// The VERSION file read from the record is sent back with the modification: if another
// ADMIN has modified it in the meantime, the server responds with a 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE.
// =========================================================================

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { ErreurApi } from '../api/erreur-api';
import { api, type TypePersonnes } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { DonneesPersonne } from '../api/types';
import { useMessages } from '../stores/messages';
import { useEnvoiFormulaire } from '../hooks/useEnvoiFormulaire';
import ChampsPersonne from '../components/ChampsPersonne';
import ChampSaisie from '../components/ChampSaisie';
import TitrePage from '../components/TitrePage';
import PageErreur from './PageErreur';
import { CLES_PERSONNES, parametres } from './personnes.config';

const VIDE: DonneesPersonne = { titre: 'Mr', prenom: '', nom: '', login: '', password: '' };

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the form itself
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
interface PropsFormulaire {
  type: TypePersonnes;
  id: number | null; // null: creation
  initial: DonneesPersonne;
}

function Formulaire({ type, id, initial }: PropsFormulaire) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const envoi = useEnvoiFormulaire();
  const [saisie, setSaisie] = useState(initial);
  const cles = CLES_PERSONNES[type];
  const creation = id === null;

  function modifier(champ: keyof DonneesPersonne, valeur: string) {
    setSaisie((s) => ({ ...s, [champ]: valeur }));
    envoi.effacerErreur(champ);
  }

  async function enregistrer(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const messages = useMessages.getState();
    const reussi = await envoi.envoyer(async () => {
      const p = id === null ? await api.ajouter(type, saisie) : await api.modifier(type, id, saisie);
      messages.flash('succes', creation ? cles.ajoute : cles.modifie, parametres(p));
    });
    const cle = useMessages.getState().erreur?.cle;
    if (reussi) {
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [type] }); // the list has changed
      navigate(`/${type}`);
    } else if (cle === 'ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND' || cle === 'ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND') {
       // deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: back to the list
      messages.flash('erreur', cle);
      navigate(`/${type}`);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="row justify-content-center">
      <div className="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
        <div className="card p-4">
          <h5 className="card-title mb-3">{t(creation ? cles.ajouter : cles.modifier)}</h5>
          {/* noValidate: SERVEUR is the valid one (it is authoritative) */}
          <form noValidate onSubmit={enregistrer}>
            <ChampsPersonne valeurs={saisie} erreurs={envoi.erreurs} onChange={modifier} />

            <h6 className="mt-4 text-muted">{t('PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION')}</h6>
            <ChampSaisie className="mb-3" idChamp="login" libelle="PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL" longueurMax={30}
                         valeur={saisie.login} onChange={(v) => modifier('login', v)} erreur={envoi.erreurs.login}
                         aide={creation ? 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_HELP_CREATE' : 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_HELP_EDIT'} />
            {/* never pre-filled: the password is never returned from the server */}
            <ChampSaisie className="mb-4" idChamp="password" type="password" libelle="PERSONNES.PASSWORD_LABEL" longueurMax={72}
                         autoComplete="new-password" valeur={saisie.password} onChange={(v) => modifier('password', v)}
                         erreur={envoi.erreurs.password} params={envoi.params}
                         aide={creation ? 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_CREATE' : 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT'} />

            <div className="d-flex gap-2">
              <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={envoi.enCours}>{t('PERSONNES.SAVE')}</button>
              <Link className="btn btn-secondary" to={`/${type}`}>{t('PERSONNES.BACK')}</Link>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the page: creating or viewing the record to be edited
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
export default function PersonneFormulaire({ type }: { type: TypePersonnes }) {
  const { id: idUrl } = useParams(); // undefined for a creation
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const cles = CLES_PERSONNES[type];
  const idValide = idUrl === undefined || /^\d+$/.test(idUrl);
  const id = idUrl === undefined || !idValide ? null : Number(idUrl);

   // modification: the record is read (including its version)
   /  / - gcTime: 0: the record is not cached after the visit; the
   /    / next visit will reload it, always up to date (otherwise the form
   /    / would load an outdated version: 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE);
   /  / - meta.erreurGeree: a read error is handled by ICI, not
   /    / by the common error handler (see main.tsx)
  const fiche = useQuery({
    queryKey: [type, id],
    queryFn: () => api.lire(type, id!),
    enabled: id !== null,
    gcTime: 0,
    meta: { erreurGeree: true },
  });

   // record does not exist (deleted in the meantime...): return to the list
  useEffect(() => {
    if (fiche.error instanceof ErreurApi) {
      useMessages.getState().flash('erreur', fiche.error.cle, fiche.error.params);
      navigate(`/${type}`);
    }
  }, [fiche.error, navigate, type]);

   // /doctors/abc/edit: this address does not exist
  if (!idValide) {
    return <PageErreur code={404} />;
  }

  const p = fiche.data;
  return (
    <>
      <TitrePage cle={id === null ? cles.ajouter : cles.modifier} />
      {id === null ? (
        <Formulaire type={type} id={null} initial={VIDE} />
      ) : (
        p && (
          <Formulaire type={type} id={id}
                      initial={{ titre: p.titre, prenom: p.prenom, nom: p.nom, login: p.login ?? '', password: '', version: p.version }} />
        )
      )}
    </>
  );
}

A single page for creation ([/medecins/ajouter]) and editing ([/medecins/3/modifier]), consisting of two components:

  • lines 46–106: the form itself. It is displayed only after the record has been read, along with DÉMARRE and its values ([useState(initial)]): there’s no need to copy them later, in an effect, when the record arrives:
    • lines 55–58: entering a field, and its error disappears;
    • lines 60–76: the save operation. For an update, [saisie] contains the VERSION read along with the record: if another ADMIN has modified it in the meantime, the server responds with a 409 [ERRORS.CONCURRENT_UPDATE];
    • lines 68–70: if successful, the list has changed: it is invalidated, then the program returns to it with the message;
    • lines 71–75: the record has been deleted in the meantime: return to the list. The other errors remain displayed on the form;
    • line 84: [noValidate]: the browser does not validate the [required] fields; it is the SERVEUR that validates, and that is the one that counts;
    • Line 91: The password field is never pre-filled: the password is never returned from the server;
  • Lines 111–159: the page:
    • line 112: the route parameter [:id], which is absent for a new creation;
    • lines 124–130: reading the record for an edit. [gcTime: 0]: the record is not cached after the visit; the next visit will re-read it, keeping it up to date (otherwise the form would start with an outdated version). [meta: { erreurGeree: true }]: A read error is handled here, rather than by the common handler (see [main.tsx]);
    • lines 133–138: record does not exist (deleted in the meantime, address entered manually...): return to the list, with a message;
    • lines 141–143: [/medecins/abc/modifier]: this address does not exist;
    • lines 149–156: a new entry: the empty form; an edit: the form, once the record has been read. [login: p.login ?? '']: a person’s login is sent only to ADMIN; it is optional in the [Personne] type.

// =========================================================================
// pages/Inscription.tsx - "Create a customer account" (/registration)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// You can only get here after entering the CAPTCHA from the login page
// ("Create a customer account" button): the server then issued a
// pass, which the road guard verified (see gardes.ts).
// Same fields as the ADMIN form, but the username and
// are required, with confirmation. Equivalent to
// views/compte/inscription.hbs in the HTML application.
// =========================================================================

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { api } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { Inscription as DonneesInscription } from '../api/types';
import { useMessages } from '../stores/messages';
import { useEnvoiFormulaire } from '../hooks/useEnvoiFormulaire';
import ChampsPersonne from '../components/ChampsPersonne';
import ChampSaisie from '../components/ChampSaisie';
import TitrePage from '../components/TitrePage';

// minimum length of a password chosen by a patient: same value
// as the server (which also returns {min} with the error PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT)
const MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN = '6';

export default function Inscription() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const envoi = useEnvoiFormulaire();
  const [saisie, setSaisie] = useState<DonneesInscription>({
    titre: 'Mr', prenom: '', nom: '', login: '', password: '', confirmation: '',
  });
   // the parameters of the ET help message for password errors
  const paramsPassword = { min: MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN, ...envoi.params };

  function modifier(champ: keyof DonneesInscription, valeur: string) {
    setSaisie((s) => ({ ...s, [champ]: valeur }));
    envoi.effacerErreur(champ);
  }

  async function creer(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    let login = '';
    const reussi = await envoi.envoyer(async () => {
      login = (await api.inscrire(saisie)).login;
    });
    const messages = useMessages.getState();
    if (reussi) {
       // Return to the login page, login pre-filled
      messages.flash('succes', 'INSCRIPTION.DONE', { login });
      navigate(`/login?login=${encodeURIComponent(login)}`);
    } else if (messages.erreur?.cle === 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT') {
       // Pass expired (15 minutes): Return to CAPTCHA
      messages.flash('erreur', 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT');
      navigate('/login');
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="row justify-content-center">
      <TitrePage cle="INSCRIPTION.TITLE" />
      <div className="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
        <div className="card p-4">
          <h5 className="card-title mb-1">{t('INSCRIPTION.TITLE')}</h5>
          <p className="text-muted small mb-3">{t('INSCRIPTION.INTRO')}</p>
          <form noValidate onSubmit={creer}>
            <ChampsPersonne valeurs={saisie} erreurs={envoi.erreurs} onChange={modifier} />

            <h6 className="mt-4 text-muted">{t('PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION')}</h6>
            <ChampSaisie className="mb-3" idChamp="login" libelle="PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL" longueurMax={30} autoComplete="username"
                         requis valeur={saisie.login} onChange={(v) => modifier('login', v)} erreur={envoi.erreurs.login}
                         aide="INSCRIPTION.LOGIN_HELP" />
            <div className="row g-3 mb-3">
              <ChampSaisie className="col-sm-6" idChamp="password" type="password" libelle="PERSONNES.PASSWORD_LABEL" longueurMax={72}
                           autoComplete="new-password" requis valeur={saisie.password} onChange={(v) => modifier('password', v)}
                           erreur={envoi.erreurs.password} params={paramsPassword} aide="INSCRIPTION.PASSWORD_HELP" />
              <ChampSaisie className="col-sm-6" idChamp="confirmation" type="password" libelle="COMPTE.CONFIRMATION_LABEL"
                           longueurMax={72} autoComplete="new-password" requis valeur={saisie.confirmation}
                           onChange={(v) => modifier('confirmation', v)} erreur={envoi.erreurs.confirmation} />
            </div>
            <div className="d-flex gap-2">
              <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={envoi.enCours}>{t('INSCRIPTION.SUBMIT')}</button>
              <Link className="btn btn-secondary" to="/login">{t('INSCRIPTION.BACK_TO_LOGIN')}</Link>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Creating a patient account. You can only proceed here after entering the CAPTCHA from the login page: the server has issued a pass, which the gatekeeper has verified.

  • line 25: the minimum password length, for the help message (“At least 6 characters.”). The server also returns this with the error [ERRORS.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT];
  • line 35: the parameters for the ET help message regarding password errors: the server’s parameters, if any, take precedence;
  • lines 42–58: account creation:
    • line 52: if successful, return to the login page with the username pre-filled;
    • lines 53–57: the token has expired (15 minutes): return to the login page for a new CAPTCHA.

// =========================================================================
// pages/EspacePatient.tsx - "My Account" (/my-account, role USER)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The patient's home page, immediately after logging in:
//    - two options: [Gérer mon compte] and [Voir un agenda];
//    - their upcoming appointment, if they have one, along with the option to cancel it.
// Equivalent to views/patient/espace.hbs in the HTML application.
// =========================================================================

import { Link } from 'react-router';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { api } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { horaire, jourLong, libelle } from '../formatage';
import { useMessages } from '../stores/messages';
import { confirmer } from '../stores/confirmation';
import TitrePage from '../components/TitrePage';

export default function EspacePatient() {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const espace = useQuery({ queryKey: ['mon-espace'], queryFn: api.monEspace });

  async function annuler(idRv: number) {
    if (!(await confirmer('AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM'))) {
      return;
    }
    const messages = useMessages.getState();
    try {
      await api.annulerRv(idRv);
      messages.afficherSucces('AGENDA.CANCELLED');
    } catch (e) {
      messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
    }
     // The ET space—the calendars have changed
    await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['mon-espace'] });
    await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['agenda'] });
  }

  const e = espace.data;
  if (!e) {
    return (
      <>
        <TitrePage cle="ESPACE.TITLE" />
        <p className="text-muted">{t('APP.LOADING')}</p>
      </>
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      <TitrePage cle="ESPACE.TITLE" />
      <h4 className="mb-3">{t('ESPACE.HELLO', { nom: libelle(e.patient) })}</h4>
      <div className="row g-3 mb-4">
        <div className="col-sm-6">
          <Link className="card p-4 h-100 text-decoration-none carte-option" to="/mon-compte">
            <h5 className="mb-1">{t('ESPACE.MANAGE_ACCOUNT')}</h5>
            <span className="text-muted">{t('ESPACE.MANAGE_ACCOUNT_HELP')}</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
        <div className="col-sm-6">
          <Link className="card p-4 h-100 text-decoration-none carte-option" to="/agenda">
            <h5 className="mb-1">{t('ESPACE.VIEW_AGENDA')}</h5>
            <span className="text-muted">{t('ESPACE.VIEW_AGENDA_HELP')}</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="card p-3">
        <h5>{t('ESPACE.MY_APPOINTMENT')}</h5>
        {/* Normally only one (rule: “one upcoming appointment at a time”),
            mais la page sait en afficher plusieurs */}
        {e.rendezVous.map((rv, i) => (
          <div key={rv.id} className={`d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-2 py-2 ${i < e.rendezVous.length - 1 ? 'border-bottom' : ''}`}>
            <div>
              <div className="fw-semibold">{jourLong(rv.jour, i18n.language)}, {horaire(rv.creneau)}</div>
              <div className="text-muted">
                {libelle(rv.medecin)} -{' '}
                {/* the doctor’s schedule for that day: the patient sees their name there */}
                <Link to={`/agenda?${new URLSearchParams({ idMedecin: String(rv.medecin.id), jour: rv.jour })}`}>
                  {t('ESPACE.SEE_IN_AGENDA')}
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline-danger" onClick={() => annuler(rv.id)}>{t('ESPACE.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT')}</button>
          </div>
        ))}
        {e.rendezVous.length === 0 && <p className="text-muted mb-0">{t('ESPACE.NO_APPOINTMENT')}</p>}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

The patient’s home page: two options, “Manage My Account” and “View Schedule,” and their upcoming appointment, which they can cancel.

  • line 22: the patient’s area. [queryFn: api.monEspace]: the function itself, without wrapping it in an arrow function; it has no parameters;
  • Lines 24–38: Cancellation, after confirmation. The ET area—the calendars have changed: both are invalidated;
  • lines 41–48: as long as the area hasn’t been read, “Loading…”;
  • lines 55–58: an entire [Bootstrap] card is a link: [<Link>] accepts any content;
  • lines 72–86: the upcoming appointment. Normally only one (the “one upcoming appointment at a time” rule), but the page can display multiple ones;
  • line 79: a link to the doctor’s schedule for that day, where the patient sees their name.

docs.title: 10.4.10.8. src/pages/MonCompte.tsx
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/MonCompte.tsx - “Manage My Account” (/my-account, role USER)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Two independent forms, such as views/patient/compte.hbs:
//    1. editing (identity, login, optional new password);
//    2. account deletion—which also cancels the user’s appointments.
// Both require the password ACTUEL (verified by the server).
// Two forms, therefore two statuses and two useEnvoiFormulaire (two sets
// sets of errors). As with PersonneFormulaire, the change is
// displayed until the account has been read, and starts with its values.
// =========================================================================

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { api } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { ModificationMonCompte, MonCompte as Compte } from '../api/types';
import { useSession } from '../stores/session';
import { useMessages } from '../stores/messages';
import { confirmer } from '../stores/confirmation';
import { useEnvoiFormulaire } from '../hooks/useEnvoiFormulaire';
import ChampsPersonne from '../components/ChampsPersonne';
import ChampSaisie from '../components/ChampSaisie';
import TitrePage from '../components/TitrePage';

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. The change
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Modification({ compte }: { compte: Compte }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const envoi = useEnvoiFormulaire();
  const [saisie, setSaisie] = useState<ModificationMonCompte>({ ...compte, password: '', confirmation: '', motDePasseActuel: '' });

  function modifier(champ: keyof ModificationMonCompte, valeur: string) {
    setSaisie((s) => ({ ...s, [champ]: valeur }));
    envoi.effacerErreur(champ);
  }

  async function enregistrer(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const reussi = await envoi.envoyer(async () => {
       // the server issued a NOUVEAU token (name, login): the
       // navigation bar must follow
      useSession.getState().mettreAJour(await api.modifierMonCompte(saisie));
      useMessages.getState().flash('succes', 'MON_COMPTE.UPDATED');
    });
    if (reussi) {
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['mon-espace'] });
      navigate('/mon-espace');
    } else {
       // never leave a password in the field after a submission is rejected;
       // change the value SANS using modify(), so as not to clear
       // the error that the server just attached to it
      setSaisie((s) => ({ ...s, motDePasseActuel: '' }));
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="card p-4 mb-4">
      <h5 className="card-title mb-3">{t('MON_COMPTE.TITLE')}</h5>
      <form noValidate onSubmit={enregistrer}>
        <ChampsPersonne valeurs={saisie} erreurs={envoi.erreurs} onChange={modifier} />

        <h6 className="mt-4 text-muted">{t('PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION')}</h6>
        <ChampSaisie className="mb-3" idChamp="login" libelle="PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL" longueurMax={30} autoComplete="username"
                     requis valeur={saisie.login} onChange={(v) => modifier('login', v)} erreur={envoi.erreurs.login} />
        <div className="row g-3 mb-3">
          <ChampSaisie className="col-sm-6" idChamp="password" type="password" libelle="MON_COMPTE.NEW_PASSWORD_LABEL"
                       longueurMax={72} autoComplete="new-password" valeur={saisie.password}
                       onChange={(v) => modifier('password', v)} erreur={envoi.erreurs.password} params={envoi.params}
                       aide="PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT" />
          <ChampSaisie className="col-sm-6" idChamp="confirmation" type="password" libelle="COMPTE.CONFIRMATION_LABEL"
                       longueurMax={72} autoComplete="new-password" valeur={saisie.confirmation}
                       onChange={(v) => modifier('confirmation', v)} erreur={envoi.erreurs.confirmation} />
        </div>
        <ChampSaisie className="mb-4" idChamp="motDePasseActuel" type="password" libelle="MON_COMPTE.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL"
                     longueurMax={72} autoComplete="current-password" requis valeur={saisie.motDePasseActuel}
                     onChange={(v) => modifier('motDePasseActuel', v)} erreur={envoi.erreurs.motDePasseActuel}
                     aide="MON_COMPTE.CURRENT_PASSWORD_HELP" />
        <div className="d-flex gap-2">
          <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={envoi.enCours}>{t('PERSONNES.SAVE')}</button>
          <Link className="btn btn-secondary" to="/mon-espace">{t('MON_COMPTE.BACK')}</Link>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. Deletion: a form with a single field
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Suppression() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const envoi = useEnvoiFormulaire();
  const [motDePasseActuel, setMotDePasseActuel] = useState('');

  async function supprimer(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!(await confirmer('MON_COMPTE.DELETE_CONFIRM'))) {
      return;
    }
    const reussi = await envoi.envoyer(() => api.supprimerMonCompte(motDePasseActuel));
    if (reussi) {
      useSession.getState().oublier(); // The server deleted the token cookie
      useMessages.getState().flash('succes', 'MON_COMPTE.DELETED');
      navigate('/login');
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="card p-4 border-danger">
      <h5 className="card-title text-danger mb-1">{t('MON_COMPTE.DELETE_TITLE')}</h5>
      <p className="text-muted small">{t('MON_COMPTE.DELETE_HELP')}</p>
      <form className="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 align-items-end" noValidate onSubmit={supprimer}>
        <ChampSaisie className="flex-grow-1" idChamp="motDePasseSuppression" type="password" libelle="MON_COMPTE.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL"
                     longueurMax={72} autoComplete="current-password" requis valeur={motDePasseActuel}
                     onChange={(v) => {
                       setMotDePasseActuel(v);
                       envoi.effacerErreur('motDePasseActuel');
                     }}
                     erreur={envoi.erreurs.motDePasseActuel} />
        <button type="submit" className="btn btn-danger" disabled={envoi.enCours}>{t('MON_COMPTE.DELETE_SUBMIT')}</button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the page
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
export default function MonCompte() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
   // gcTime: 0: re-read on every visit (its version must be up to date)
  const compte = useQuery({ queryKey: ['mon-compte'], queryFn: api.monCompte, gcTime: 0 });

  return (
    <div className="row justify-content-center">
      <TitrePage cle="MON_COMPTE.TITLE" />
      <div className="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
        {compte.data ? <Modification compte={compte.data} /> : <p className="text-muted">{t('APP.LOADING')}</p>}
        <Suppression />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Two independent forms, and therefore two components, each with its own state and [useEnvoiFormulaire] (two sets of errors):

  • lines 30–90: modification of the identity, login, and, optionally, the password:
    • line 35: the form starts with the account values (including its version), with the password fields empty;
    • line 47: the server has issued a NOUVEAU token, with the new name and new login, and redirects the user: it is stored in the session store, and the navigation bar updates accordingly;
    • lines 53–58: a submission was rejected: a password must never be left in a field. We change the value SANS to [modifier()], so as not to clear the error that the server just attached to the field;
  • lines 95–130: Deleting the account, which also cancels its appointments:
    • line 99: a form with a single field: a single string;
    • lines 107–111: the account is deleted, and the server has cleared the token cookie: the client forgets the user, then the login page, along with the message;
  • lines 135–149: the page. [gcTime: 0]: the account is re-read on every visit; its version must be up to date. The deletion is displayed immediately; the modification, once the account has been read.
